name: MindAtlas TypeScript & Spec Integrity Hook
description: Validates strict TypeScript types and verifies Three.js disposal rules whenever a source file is saved.

action.prompt: Check the saved file against `.kiro/steering/frankenstein-rules.md` and `.kiro/specs/mind-atlas-3d/design.md`. Verify there are no `any` types and that any Three.js geometries or materials created are properly cleaned up.
